outgoing.name: Belarus
outgoing.excerpt: During Operation Bagration, the general counteroffensive in Belarus, Vasilevsky coordinated the offensives of the 1st Baltic and 3rd Belorussian Fronts.

outgoing.name: Polish-Soviet War
outgoing.excerpt: At the beginning of the October Revolution and the Civil War he was conscripted into the Red Army, taking part in the Polish-Soviet War.

outgoing.name: Virtuti Militari
outgoing.excerpt: In addition to Soviet orders and medals, Vasilevsky was awarded several foreign decorations such as the Polish Virtuti Militari Order from the Polish communist government.
